name: x-article-hooks
title_zh: 文章太长没人看？它替你写三条短钩子
tagline_zh: 发推、发圈、转给同事，开头三行定生死。它不重写全文，只从原文里捞出最扎人的 payoff，生成发布语。
tagline_en: Posting an article? The first 3 lines decide everything. It mines your piece for the sharpest payoff and hands.
desc_en: Write a short launch caption, quote-post hook, or agent handoff for an existing article. Use for concise copy that communicates the payoff without rewriting the full article.
why_zh: 不碰正文结构，只做「提取—压缩—换语境」三步。它知道发布语要勾人、引用钩要断章取义地准。
why_en: It never rewrites your piece—only extracts, compresses, and re-contextualizes. Three distinct voices for three distinct jobs.
limit_zh: 只吃已写好的文章全文，不吃大纲或口述。产出是短文案，不含配图建议、话题标签或发布排期。原文若本身没有鲜明观点或数据。
limit_en: Needs full finished text—no outlines or spoken notes. Output is copy only: no image ideas, hashtags, or posting schedule. If the source lacks a.
title_en: Turn one long article into 3 short hooks
